title: P2 Remediation: LtHash Custom DST Length-Prefix Framing, AES-256-CTR Profile, Stack Reduction & Constant-Time Equality
public_safety_audit_summary: Moderate (Cryptographic Domain Separation, Interop & Side-Channel Hardening): Custom dst tags in LtHash lack length-prefix framing, AES-256-CTR (msc4500:lthash16:aes-ctr:v1) lacks a library profile selector for gomatrixcrypto interop, PduLtHash::checksum() clones 6 KiB on the stack, benches/aesctr_crosscheck.rs wraps u16 length prefixes without slicing, and LtLattice/StateDigest equality comparisons are non-constant-time.
